title: 2013 AMC 12B Problem 1
statement: On a particular January day, the high temperature in Lincoln, Nebraska, was \(16\) degrees higher than the low temperature, and the average of the high and low temperatures was \(3^\circ.\) In degrees, what was the low temperature in Lincoln that day?

solutions.text: The high exceeds the low by \(16,\) so the low is \(8\) below the average. Since the average is \(3^\circ,\) the low temperature is \(3 - 8 = -5^\circ.\) Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The high and low differ by \(16,\) so each is \(8\) away from their average
The low temperature is \(8\) below the average of \(3\)
